diagnostic_steps: Extract the invalid table name from the error message.
Search the Knowledge Base for the closest matching valid table name.
Check if the invalid table name is actually an alias that was not defined in the FROM clause.
repair_strategies: Replace the invalid table name with the closest matching valid table name.
Define the missing alias in the FROM clause.

diagnostic_steps: Extract the invalid column name from the error message.
Identify the table(s) involved in the query.
Search the Knowledge Base for the closest matching valid column name within the involved tables.
repair_strategies: Replace the invalid column name with the closest matching valid column name.
If the column belongs to a different table, ensure the table is properly joined.

diagnostic_steps: Extract the ambiguous column name from the error message.
Identify all tables in the query that contain this column name.
repair_strategies: Prefix the ambiguous column name with the appropriate table alias.
